name: EmptyState
purpose: Present empty content with consistent visual hierarchy and application-owned next steps.
useWhen: A collection or workspace has no content to display.

avoidWhen.condition: A durable error needs status emphasis.

composition: Compose Root and Content with optional Indicator, Title, Description and authored actions. Choose Title's heading level independently from size.

Group Title and Description with VStack gap={2}; Content separates the glyph, text group and ButtonGroup. Size and align accept sparse responsive values; omitted initial values use md and center. Keep paint on Card or Surface.

rules.statement: Keep copy, data classification, filtering and actions application-owned; EmptyState has no implicit live role or viewport height.
Load styles.css or core.css plus empty-state.css and the CSS of additional composed owners.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the indicator slot as a full-size image frame.
commonMistakes.correction: Place authored illustration content in Image or Frame outside the fixed glyph slot.

validation: Check three densities, invariant icon geometry, transparent roots, heading semantics, long RTL copy and wrapping actions in light/dark.
